question: Who among the following was elected as the 80th president of United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dennis Francis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dennis Francis**, a diplomat from **Trinidad and Tobago**, was elected as the **80th President of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)** in June 2025.
 
• He is recognized for his extensive experience in international diplomacy, having served as his country's **Permanent Representative to the United Nations** in New York since 2016.
 
• His election as the UNGA President emphasizes the importance of representation from smaller states, particularly from the **Caribbean region**, in global governance.
 
• The **UN General Assembly** presidency rotates annually among the five geographic groups: Africa, Asia-Pacific, Eastern Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Western Europe and Others. In 2025, it was the turn of the Latin America and Caribbean Group (GRULAC).
 
• Francis's priorities as the UNGA President include addressing **climate change**, promoting **sustainable development**, and fostering **peace and security** globally.
